description: This file defines the EasterEggs class which creates a list of Easter egg instances, including Chewbacca and David Bowie themed Easter eggs, for the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: EasterEggs
classes.description: Main class providing a static method to create a list of Easter egg instances.

classes.name: ChewbaccaEasterEgg
classes.description: Inner class representing a Chewbacca-themed Easter egg, extending OnKeyEasterEggBaseImpl.

classes.name: DavidBowieEasterEgg
classes.description: Inner class representing a David Bowie-themed Easter egg, extending OnKeyEasterEggBaseImpl.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of Easter egg instances including Chewbacca and David Bowie.

methods.name: ChewbaccaEasterEgg (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a Chewbacca Easter egg with specific parameters.

methods.name: DavidBowieEasterEgg (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a David Bowie Easter egg with lyrics and a playlist URL.
